notes.title: Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon
Patch Note V1.1.2_Beta[/h1]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Changed the Flash effect of Katanas from Lethal Slay to Rampage.
  [*] Lethal Slay has been reworked.
   -The amount of damage dealt will now be shown when Flash is triggered by a weapon with Lethal Slay as its Flash effect.
   -Landing Lethal Slay against enemies within Nurarihyon's area of effect will now cause the damage inflicted to ignore the damage reduction granted by Nurarihyon.
   -Adjusted the damage scaling of Lethal Slay depending on the chosen difficulty.
   Lethal Slay will still deal damage equal to 100% of enemy max vitality in Commoner, but is reduced for every difficulty after.
   However, depending on the inherent damage of the weapon being used, the damage of Lethal Slay will be determined by the Flash bonus modifier instead.
   -Lethal Slay will now account for the damage bonuses upon triggering Flash.
   -The max vitality damage of Lethal Slay will now only apply when it is greater than the damage of the weapon used multiplied by Flash bonus modifiers.
  [*] The base values and bonuses gained per rank increase of effects provided by Talismans have been reduced.
  [*] Changed the design of the spear traps.
  [*] Changed the design of the guillotine traps.
  [*] Strengthened the status effect resistance bonuses on certain weapons.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Fixed an issue in which it was possible to recover vitality through equipping Talismans that provided max vitality increases as bonuses.
  [*] Fixed an issue in which Afterlife Talisman did not recover vitality as is intended under certain circumstances.

 [*]Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
  [*] We are looking into an issue in which the health bonuses from equipping certain Talismans are higher than intended.
  [*] We are looking into an issue in which the one-use effect of Afterlife Talisman is unintendedly being restored at the beginning of the boss fight.
  [*] We are looking into an issue in which meeting the conditions for triggering Determination would consume and nullify Afterlife Talisman's one-use effect.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon
Patch Notes V1.1.1_Beta[/h1]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Keys are no longer needed to access unlockable stages.
[*] The display of the attack power of Dual Wield Weapons has been changed to the value of one weapon. This change also raises the number of combos from 5 to 9.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Extended the activation interval of the Damage Absorb mechanic.
[*] Adjusted the bonus damage increase caused by the Rampage effect of Dual Wield Weapons so that it matches that of other weapons.
[*] Reduced the hitbox of the Armored Spirit's long-range blade attack.
[*] Adjusted the projectiles fired by the Geisha Spirit (Turned) so that they always fly forwards.
[*] Enemies will now receive damage caused by status effects from the moment they are inflicted.
[*] Shortened the time it takes for an enemy to move if they are attacked by the player while Frozen.
[*] Reduced the travel speed of trap arrows and floating crossbow arrows.
[*] Reduced the damage caused by traps (thorn beds, trap arrows, trap spears, and guillotines).
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which the camera would occasionally not return to its initial position after a Flash animation.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the enhancements provided by the Primal Refuge Talisman were not being applied correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue in which misaligned traps in the Subspace Citadel would cause the player to be unable to climb over certain ledges.
[*] Fixed an issue in which enemies would not appear in certain sections of Avenue of Pleasure and Illusion.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Tremor Pillbug would be damaged twice per hit.
[*] Fixed an issue in which different Talismans with different effects would not be compared when exchanging Talismans.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain stage features would disappear when resuming the game after it had been suspended.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note(Beta version)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] When participating in the Beta test, all difficulty levels, characters, Mastery and Training skills along with all weapons and their respective attributes will be unlocked.
[*] Changes/additions to combat systems.
After performing an aerial attack during your first jump, you may now perform another set of normal aerial attacks or a unique action upon double-jumping.
*Unique actions that bring the user to the ground are unaffected by this change.
[*] Adjustments to the Flash mechanic.
Triggering Flash on a non-boss enemy will now also trigger the Lethal Slay or Rampage effects depending on the weapon used.
Lethal Slay: Deals a percentage damage of the target's health scaled to the selected difficulty. In all difficulty levels up to the newly released Devotee difficulty, enemies that are suspectible to Lethal Slay upon triggering Flash will be defeated in a single hit.
Rampage: Each time Flash is triggered on an enemy, the amount of damage that enemy will receive from further attacks gradually increases. The damage modifier imposed on the enemy will remain until the playable character is struck by any enemy. This modifier also applies to the normal attacks of certain weapons that do not trigger Flash.  Training skills count towards the overall effect of Rampage.
*No changes have been made to triggering Flash on bosses.
The distribution of Flash effects between weapons is as follows.
Lethal Slay: Triggered by Katanas, Bludgeons, Battle Umbrellas, Whips and Polearms.
Rampage: Triggered by Spears, Dual Wield Weapons, and Gauntlets.
[*] New audiovisual effects will now appear when Flash is triggered.
[*] Adjustments to the Parry system.
Damage Absorb, Projectile Parry, and Counter Slash have been newly implemented. These mechanics can be utilized by weapons that possess guarding moves, with Damage Absorb being a unique mechanic of Battle Umbrellas and Counter Slash being a unique mechanic of Polearms.
The Projectile Parry effect can be utilized by both Battle Umbrellas and Polearms.
The effects of each mechanic are as follows.
Damage Absorb: Heal for an amount based on the player character's maximum Vitality upon a successful parry.
Damage Absorb cannot be triggered until a certain interval of time has pased since it was previously triggered.
Projectile Parry:  Reflect enemy projectiles when using Parry at precise timings.
Note that Projectile Parry has no effect on certain enemy projectiles.
Counter Slash: Increase damage inflicted by a player's first hit for a limited amount of time after successfully guarding from an enemy attack.
[*] Adjustments to how guarding with the Battle Umbrella and Polearm functions.
Damage received when utilizing a unique action with a guarding function has been significantly decreased.
Guard breaks have been adjusted to now occur more frequently.
[*] Polearms have been added as the new main weapon. Polearms have Parry as their unique action.
Polearms are extraordinarily well-rounded weapons that have high damage output and substantial reach, while also being able to guard, parry enemy attacks, and grant Counter Slash with their unique action.
[*] Talismans have been added as the new subweapon.
Talismans grant passive effects when they are equiped, but do not have any active modes or triggers.
Make use of the various empowering secondary effects that Talismans provide to tackle any situation.
[*] Balance changes to weapons.
Bludgeons: Base damage values have been significantly increased.
Gauntlets: Base damage and Break damage values have been significantly increased.
Enemies are now launched at an adjusted direction and height by the 4th normal attack strike, allowing for easier follow-up aerial attacks.
Battle Umbrellas: Enemy attacks inflict less damage while you are guarding.
Matchlocks: The base damage value and damage per rank have been reduced for Nationfeller, the Great Cannon.
Explosives: Base damage of all Explosives has been reduced.
Caltrops: It is now possible to strike aerial enemies.
[*] Adjustments to Demonization.
Demonization effects are no longer subject to a time limit.
Demonization effects no longer disappear after clearing a boss battle.
[*] Added new action patterns to certain enemies who approach the playable character on the ground.
[*] New enemies Tremor Pillbug, Baboon, and Mad Scorpion have been added.
The newly added enemies will appear from the Devotee difficulty onwards.
[*] Stages have been changed to now include traps placed at random locations.
More traps will be placed when the game is played at a higher difficulty.
[*] Added a 5th selectable difficulty, Devotee.
[*] Adjusted the parameters of enemy bosses.
[/list]

Hotfix (March 18, 2022)
Fixed certain bugs found in the beta test version (V1.1.0_β). 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Flash bonus damage did not apply when triggering Rampage
[*] Fixed an issue in which the bonus damage on normal attacks provided by Rampage became higher than its intended value.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the number of hits needed to trigger Demonization was set to a higher value than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Berserker form of Mad Scorpian did not drop a Soul.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/237e9a8d88ed94463f1ff74c95434ebd1e2fe331.png[/img]

Thank you for providing your invaluable feedback, especially during the game's Early Access period.

[h1]Important notice[/h1]
Updating the game to V1.0.0 will delete all Suspended-Game Data. As this affects ongoing runs, return to the Getsu Clan Estate before downloading the update if you wish to keep your materials.
Your Save Data will not be affected and can be loaded as normal from the main menu.

[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon Patch Notes V1.0.0[/h1]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Changed minimap icons from "!" to ones that are easier to distinguish.
  [*]Adjustments to Whips.
Fixed a bug where hitting an enemy with the sweet spot of the regular attack would sometimes not do double damage.
Changed the visual effects of when Flash is triggered.
  [*]Reduced the duration and reach of the poison trap's hitbox in the Cocytus.
  [*]Improved the Soul Devour UI's visibility by adjusting its size.
  [*]Adjusted certain on-screen effects.
  [*]After teleporting, the player's character is invulnerable for longer and enemies take longer to move.
  [*]Made changes to the debuffs and status effect resistances of certain enemies.
  [*]Damage from Bleed's additional effect - Rupture - is now calculated by using "Current Vitality" instead of "Maximum Vitality".
  [*]Increased the base damage and inflicted damage frequency of Poison and Blight.
  [*]Increased the base damage of Burn and Scorch and increased the spark damage inflicted by Scorch.
  [*]Tenaga-Ashinaga is no longer invulnerable during the animation of its separation, and can now be killed through conventional means. 
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Updated Unreal Engine to V4.27.1.
  [*]Turning off blood animations in options will now also hide other blood visuals such as those found on the ground or on objects.
  [*]Changed parts of the tutorial.
  [*]Changed the regular attack and Slay sound effects for the Gauntlet and Bludgeon.
  [*]The Hall of Treasures is no longer accessible the first time you enter the Getsu Clan Estate.
  [*]If your save data becomes corrupted, it will now be treated as a corrupted file. 
  [*]Removed achievements previously listed that cannot be cleared as of V1.0.0.
The achievement list will be adjusted in line with the content of future updates.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the menu would open during certain cutscenes.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which if the player's character overlapped with certain enemies while they were performing a specific action, the enemy would become still and be unable to move.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which certain enemies would fall through the map.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the player's character would deal damage equivalent to two hits when they strike certain enemies while changing the direction they are facing.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which enemies were unable to move if they ended up outside of their programmed movement area.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which enemies' character models were not being displayed properly after being defeated. 
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the controller would not vibrate as intended when attacked by certain enemies.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which some settings would not reset after selecting "Restore to default settings".
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the models for the sub weapons Blazing Caltrops and Bloody Caltrops were swapped.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the display order of the player character and chests was reversed in specific circumstances.
  [*]Fixed an issue with Whips in which their hitboxes would persist beyond their intended duration when the player character performed certain action patterns.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the correct color and effects for critical attacks using Whips on certain enemies would not display properly.
  [*]Fixed an issue with boss fights in which the "Times Hit" counter would not work when the player character died to a non-boss unit.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which item drops become invisible under certain conditions.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which Ravenous Demon's enhanced state would be nullified upon restarting the game.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the corpses of certain enemies would not disappear if the player's character had triggered Rupture and Break on them simultaneously.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which Slay damage would be higher than intended when it is triggered through the 4th hit of the Gauntlet's attack combo on the ground.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the visual effect of the Nine-Tailed Fox's roar would not be displayed correctly.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the 絶 character is mispositioned when Parry is triggered on certain bosses.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the Slow status effect inflicted on Tenaga-Ashinaga would be unintendedly removed after their separation.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the Parasite status effect would persist even if enemies were sufficiently far away for it to be nullified.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the Parasite status effect would be nullified immediately after it was inflicted on an enemy.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which certain enemies and bosses would not take damage from the sparks generated from the Scorch status effect.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which status effect icons would not be displayed correctly on enemies that spawned during boss battles.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the player character could not be controlled in the scenario that only a single sub weapon was equipped and the order of sub weapons was swapped while it was being used.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the total number of coins accumulated through the Mastery skill Miser would reset after quitting and relaunching the game.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which parts of the UI in the menu would not be displayed correctly.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which environmental objects would not break correctly.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the visual alert for the falling icicles in Cocytus would not display correctly.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which the camera for the Getsu Clan Estate would not behave as intended during the revival sequence when the game is set to specific screen resolutions.
  [*]Fixed a bug in which using Gauntlets on several enemies that were in the Break state would not trigger Slay on all of them simultaneously.

  [*]Corrected a number of sound effects which were not being played as intended.
  [*]Corrected a number of texts.
  [*]Optimized various elements.
  [*]Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for playing the game in the Early Access period and providing precious opinions with us.
The update is based on the feedback we have received so far.
We will continue improving this game further based on your opinions!

[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon 
Patch Notes V0.4.10[/h1]

[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
 [*]Added the new main weapon, Whip. A total of five variations are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/c6b5c8b0b45d750f9d037b1b8f90a6ab793141cd.jpg[/img]

Whips have the longest range of all main weapons, allowing you to deal significant damage to distant enemies with ease.
Also, you can increase the power and range of their unique actions by charging them.
Since it rewards technical playstyles, pay attention to your positioning to maximize the advantages you get out of this weapon!
* Of the five Whip variations, two will be unlocked by default.

[previewyoutube=1ZWb_52jolM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3][/h3]
 [*]With this addition, Whips, Whip Fragments and the diagrams for Beastkiller Whip, Poison Whip Adder, and Onitsuta, the Bloodthirsty Chain will drop from treasure boxes and defeated enemies.
 [*]Added the new difficulty "Apprentice".
Difficulty can be changed at the Training Statue or when starting a new save file. 
Although it is more accessible than the "Commoner" difficulty, there are less stages you can travel to.
While item drop rates are the same as "Commoner", interruptions (random encounters) will not be triggered when travelling between stages.
 [*]Controller vibration is now available. You can enable this feature in the Options menu.
 [*]Added the new Secret Art, "Weapon Rack Order". Through unlocking and enhancing "Weapon Rack Order", a maximum of two new weapon racks will be added to the Getsu Clan Estate.
[*][i](Community)[/i] New options have been added for adjusting Blood Animations.
Not only can they be toggled on or off, they can be set to one of four available colors.

[previewyoutube=zas8I2yXd0U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:

[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon 
Patch Notes V0.3.13[/h1]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*](Community) Increased the amount of rewards dropped after defeating the Final Boss.
  [*](Community) Increased the drop rates of the Marine Key, Snowy Key and Dull Key.
  [*]Increased the duration of the player character's invincibility after being hit by a trap.
  [*](Community) The floating crossbow in Subspace Citadel can now be attacked.
Dealing damage to the floating crossbows prevents them from moving for a set period of time.
Note that the eyes of a floating crossbow indicate whether it is active or not.
  [*](Community) The number of floating crossbows placed in the Subspace Citadel has been adjusted.
  [*](Community) The interval time between the floating crossbows' attacks has been adjusted. 
  [*]Reduced the hitbox duration of Oni's (Club) second attack.
  [*]Adjusted Daidarabotchi's attack patterns, reducing the frequency of its movement.
  [*]Reduced the distance of Wanyudo's backward wind-up before it attacks.
  [*]Adjusted Ravenous Demon's hitbox so that it can hit players at point-blank range.
  [*](Community) Lowered the sound effect volume when the low-vitality alert is triggered.
  [*](Community) Decreased the status effect duration of the poison traps in the Cocytus.
  [*](Community) Adjusted the materials' prices in the Shop. 
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Increased the maximum range of Matchlocks.
  [*]Reworked the functionality of Kunais so that their flight speeds are no longer reduced after bouncing back from a wall.
  [*]Increased the number of hits required to trigger Rupture on an enemy.
  [*]Status Effects will no longer be applied on enemies during their Break state.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]

  [*]Fixed an issue in which Daidarabotchi would be placed in the Break state again when the game is paused and unpaused after one instance of application.

  [*]Fixed an issue in which Flash triggered on one enemy would apply to another that is suffering from a Status Effect.

  [*]Fixed an issue in which the incorrect sound effects played with certain functions.

  [*]Corrected a number of in-game guides.

  [*]Corrected the Tutorial for the Freeze and Parasite status effects.

  [*]Fixed an issue with certain languages in which the text would extend beyond their intended space.
  [*]Fixed an issue with certain languages in which the text would overlap with one another.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/074c6077d3e28c08b4f5b1bd026f4c5eb205b155.png[/img]
Thank you for providing your invaluable feedback, especially during the game's Early Access period.
The adjustments/improvements marked as (Community) were made based on feedback from our Steam Community, Twitter and Discord users. We will keep on improving the game based on everyone's opinions.

[h1]GetsuFumaDen:Undying Moon Patch Notes Ver0.3.8[/h1]

[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Added the new stage "Subspace Citadel" and the new boss "Daidarabotchi".
Subspace Citadel is the fourth stage and can be accessed after clearing Misty Peaks and Frozen Graveyard.
You must acquire the "Dull Key" to unlock the Subspace Citadel.
  [*]Added the new enemies Shishi Gashira and Tenaga-Ashinaga.
Both will appear in Subspace Citadel with this update.
  [*]Added the Raise Equipment Rank feature.
The Raise Equipment Rank feature allows you to spend Soul Memories and coins to raise the rank of your equipment.
This feature can be accessed by speaking with the blue Shrine Maiden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/f423c2d841fa921280f2185b0d63a143137415c6.png[/img]
  [*](Community) Added the Hall of Treasures, which can be accessed to the left of the Shrine Maiden standing by the Getsu Clan Estate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/a941a2b3e166823da5629d611fd9b89e8ab4025c.png[/img]
Added the Spirit Scrolls as a Hall of Treasures feature. They can be viewed via the Battle Record in the Hall of Treasures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/fabf61337fa373510f2c49e9a4635c410e5da81f.png[/img]
The "Battle Record" feature allows you to view information about the enemies whom you have defeated before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/37a03624272d4a127234320f5ad0ec1524be4424.png[/img]
We will continue to expand on the Hall of Treasures in future updates.
  [*](Community) Added a display at the edge of the screen that alerts you when your vitality is low.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*](Community) The Shrine Maiden who can activate equipment skills now also appears at each stage's shop.
You can now activate equipment skills and raise your equipment's ranks at the shops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/6ab379567334f0eed36eafdc0bca66607ac2f360.png[/img]

  [*]Adjusted Soul Devour's Main+ and Unlock Skill enhancement bonuses.
All main weapons will now possess the "Attack +" quality.
Through this change, the effects of increasing rank and Soul Devour used on your main weapons are now more obvious.
Note: The strength of the effects varies based on the weapon.
  [*]Reduced the effects of the weapon skills "Teachings of Destruction" and "Essence of Destruction" as they were too strong.
Teachings of Destruction 10 → 3
Essence of Destruction 5% → 3%
  [*]Strengthened the effect of "Break Attack +" and the increase effect when activating Soul Devour.

  [*]Adjusted Soul Devour's sub weapon qualities.
Sub weapons that do not have either the "Cooldown -" or "Ammo +" qualities will now possess the "Cooldown -" quality.
This applies to Kunai of the Poisoned Fang, Inferno Kunai, Kunai of the Bloody Tear, Frozen Kunai, Lifestealing Kunai, Kunai of Swift Strikes, all Mana Bracelets, and all Matchlocks.
  [*]Strengthened the "Cooldown -" effect.

  [*]Adjusted equipment drops from enemies so that they will be more balanced.
  [*]Adjusted the rarity rates of equipment dropped from enemies or found in chests.
While this has increased the Rare/Epic drop rates, the Relic/Legendary drop rates have not been altered.

  [*](Community) Added a total ammo display to the equipment panel.
  [*]In conjunction with the implementation of the "Raise Equipment Rank" feature, added an auxiliary rank display to the equipment panel.
  [*](Community) Added a total ammo display to the sub weapon HUD.
  [*](Community) Adjusted the vitality gauge display to improve its visibility.
  [*](Community) Added an option that reverses left/right scrolling controls when on the map screen.
This can be accessed via Options > Settings > Controls.
  [*]Adjusted the hit effect when attacking stone objects, improving its feel.
  [*](Community) Adjusted the final Demonization visual effects during the Getsu Rando fight to improve visibility.

  [*]Added a warning that displays for a certain period of time when the screen resolution is changed.
  [*]Shortened the length of The Great Wave of Damnation stage.
  [*]Shops will now always appear in The Great Wave of Damnation stage.
  [*]Equipment shops will now always appear in the Misty Peaks stage.

  [*]Adjusted various hitboxes.
　Oni (Club): Erased the backward hitbox when it raises its club.
　Numagozen: Erased the backward hitbox during its attacks.
　Oni (Bell): Shrunk the hitbox area of its attack as it was larger than its animation.
　Armored Spirit (Tentacle): Changed its hitbox area to match its attack motion.
　Stone Whelp/Infected Cicada: Shortened the active duration of their explosion hitboxes.
　Hydra of the Depths: Shrunk the bite attack hitbox.
　Colossal Centipede: Shortened the active duration of the poison explosion hitbox.
　Wanyudo: Shortened the active duration of its hitbox and adjusted the hitbox after it passes by.
　Subterranean Spider: Expanded the hitbox around its body during the spin attack.
　Nine-Tailed Fox: Erased the hitbox during the end of the spin attack animation.
　Getsu Rando: Fixed an issue in which attacks would land from unnatural positions.
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Status effects can now be applied simultaneously, instead of through a priority system.
This means that if your weapons can inflict multiple status effects, they can all be applied at the same time.
  [*]Changed the effect of Bleed when applied on enemies so that they will take damage at regular intervals regardless of whether or not they are performing an action.
Note: Bleed is unchanged when Players are the ones affected, dealing damage only during movement.
  [*]Added additional effects to Poison, Burn, and Bleed.
After inflicting Poison, Burn, or Bleed on an enemy, hitting them again a certain number of times with a weapon that can inflict the same status effect will activate the additional effects.
The additional effects are as follows.

　Poison additional effect: Blight
　　[Condition]
　　　Hit a Poisoned enemy with Poison attacks a certain number of times.
　　[Effect]
　　　Blight changes the effect's color from green to purple and will no longer disappear over time. 
　　　Enemies inflicted with Blight will explode upon death, inflicting Poison on any enemy that is
　　　hit by the explosion.
　Burn additional effect: Scorch
　　[Condition]
　　　Hit a Burned enemy with Burn attacks a certain number of times.
　　[Effect]
　　　The affected enemy will spread sparks as they take damage over time. Enemies that
　　　touch these sparks will be Burned. The sparks will disappear after touching an enemy
　　　or after a certain amount of time passes.
　Bleed additional effect: Rupture
　　[Condition]
　　　Hit a Bleeding enemy with Bleed attacks a certain number of times.
　　[Effect]
　　　Deals additional damage to the target. Rupture can be inflicted on the same enemy 
　　　multiple times, but the required number of hits increases each time.
  [*]In conjunction with the new additional effects, an icon of the inflicted status effect will now be displayed above the afflicted target's vitality gauge.

  [*]Readjusted the functionality of equipment rank and rarity.
Instead of rank and rarity both increasing attack power, their purposes have now been diversified.
Weapon attack power will now only scale with rank, whereas rarity increases the skills already activated.
Also, depending on rarity, equipment skills may now be activated even if they were not previously unlocked.

  [*]When Desperation activates, all status effects and debuffs will be removed.
Added an explanation for Desperation in the help menu.

  [*]Extended the effects of Mastery skills "Increased Weapon Quality" and "Increased Weapon Quality: Mastery" so that they now also apply to weapons available at the Getsu Clan Estate.
However, the Nameless Katana found next to the Training Statue is unaffected by this change.
Also, the Nameless Katana can now appear in the weapon rack and receive the Mastery skill effects.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]Fixed an issue in which holding down the Cancel button to skip would not work if "Cancel" was mapped to a different button through Key Configuration.
  [*]Fixed a known issue in which enemies behaved unnaturally in narrow areas.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which Armored Spirits' slashing attacks would disappear due to clipping.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which certain attacks from Getsu Rando had more knockback than expected.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which screen resolution could not be selected on certain screen resolutions.
  [*]Fixed an issue in which the text for certain languages stuck out beyond the text window.
  [*]Fixed an issue of overlapping text in certain languages.
  [*]Other miscellaneous improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/aeb1aed57294abb6581fa90be9241c52162aa400.png[/img]

Thank you for playing the game in the Early Access period and providing precious opinions with us.
The update is based on the feedback we have received so far.
We will continue improving this game further based on your opinions!

[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon 
Patch Notes V0.2.14[/h1]

[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
  [*]  (Community) Renge's Remnants now appears in-game.
   After you defeat Puppet Getsu Renge, Getsu Renge's Remnants will randomly appear to antagonize you between stages, just like Puppet Getsu Renge.
  [*]  Added "No interruptions" to Options.
   Turning this option on prevents Puppet Getsu Renge and Renge's Remnants from appearing in-game.
   This option must be turned on to get the Unequaled Bravery achievement, and turned off to get the Prison of Souls achievement or make Getsu Renge a playable character.
   This option can only be changed from the title screen's settings, and not from the in-game settings.
  [*]  (Community) Added a feature for changing the controller button design on the UI.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]  (Community) The Super Armor (SA) that activates during player actions now also reduces damage as well as preventing actions being interrupted.
   As such, a damage-reducing effect has been added to all club actions, unique actions with spears, Mana Ring actions, and all actions with weapons equipped with the rare skill Determination.
  [*]  Added color to damage values when damage is subtracted.
   Damage is displayed in blue when the player or an enemy is guarding and when Super Armor (SA) activates.
  [*]  Adjusted the main weapon Bludgeon.
   Increased the power and activation speed of the second grounded attack. Reduced the charge time for grounded unique actions.
  [*] Changed the rewards received from Puppet battles. Instead of a treasure box with 4 Souls, the reward will now restore some vitality and raise main weapon, subweapon, and stamina enhancements each by one Soul Devour level.
   The rewards from Remnants battles will be the same.
  [*]  (Community) Revised the player detection rules for Geisha Spirit and Geisha Spirit (Turned), and adjusted them so they are less likely to attack the player from the player's blindspot.
  Rebalanced vitality increase for Soul Devour.
  [*]  (Community) When dismantling weapons in Frozen Graveyard, characters are no longer moved forcibly by the blizzard effect.
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*]  (Community) Adjusted the status effect hitbox for weapons.
  If skills are of the same type, whichever has the greater effect amount/time is applied. However, their chances of activation are added together.
  If skills are of different types, the one with the highest chance of activation will be given priority, and the status effect that activates first will be applied.
   Effects of the rare skills "Purple Liquid", "Orange Flames", "Vermilion Blood", "Blue Ice" and "Yellow Magic" have been applied to all attack actions.
  [*] The weapon skill Spirit Absorption can now take effect even when inflicting less than 100 damage.
  [*]  Players no longer approach enemies after being attacked and knocked back at the edge of the screen.
  [*]  (Community) Items are now purchased from shops when weapons are equipped as opposed to when weapons are picked up.
  [*]  (Community) Limited which keys can scroll through loading tips.
  [*]  (Community) Added zoom in/out to the map displayed when fast travelling between locations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/f57243b6fd9d77ab239f87a8e1546a8b945b9a05.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*]  Fixed a rare issue where the player moves to a nonexistent area when passing through a Torii (Gold).
  [*]  Fixed an issue that occurred when moving between stages after moving a subweapon to another button. If only one subweapon was equipped, two of the same subweapons ended up being equipped.
  [*]  Fixed the Freeze effect so that it works on Puppet Getsu Renge.
  [*] Fixed a bug that occurred during some of Puppet Getsu Renge's actions.
  [*] Fixed a screen bug that occurred when suspending and then resuming the game immediately after defeating Puppet Getsu Renge.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that prevented the achievement Prison of Souls from being attained.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that nullified attacks until Freeze wears off from a defeated enemy.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that caused the Shrine Maiden's dialogue to overlap.
  [*]  Fixed an issue where the level of weapons dropped in some stages was not suitable.
  [*]  Fixed an issue where the voices of the Twin Tempest Demons did not play correctly.
  [*]  Fixed some incorrect text.
  [*]  Fixed an issue where unexpected enemies appeared in the Frozen Graveyard and The Great Wave of Damnation.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that prevented the player from returning to the back of Avenue of Pleasure and Illusion immediately after moving to the front via the gate.
  [*]  Fixed an issue that caused a status effect placed on an enemy to disappear when they moved between the front and back of Avenue of Pleasure and Illusion.
  [*] Fixed an issue wherein vitality recovered when triggering Slay on an enemy with a weapon containing Spirit Absorption.
  [*]  Fixed an issue where the monument interaction guide did not display correctly.
  [*]  Fixed an issue where the background water surface effect continues to be displayed after the player defeats the Hydra of the Depths.
  [*]  Fixed an issue in which a window mode resolution higher than the set resolution could not be selected after it was set to a resolution lower than the monitor being used.
  [*]  Fixed UI inconsistencies.
  [*]  Fixed an issue wherein the wrong audio played in part of the UI.
[/list]
[list]
  [*]  Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h1]GetsuFumaDen(FC)
Patch Notes V1.0.2[/h1]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
 [*] Fixed a number of text/display-related errors.
 [*] Fixed system errors that may occur when using a 4K monitor.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/4a975d0f72c4ac9d4ef76ca734bf47af7b6678d0.png[/img]
Thank you for providing your invaluable feedback, especially during the game's Early Access period.
The adjustments/improvements marked as (Community) were made based on feedback from our Steam Community, Twitter and Discord users. We will keep on improving the game based on everyone's opinions.

[h1]GetsuFumaDen:Undying Moon Patch Notes V0.2.8[/h1]

[h3]New Additions[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Added the new playable character, Getsu Renge.
  Puppet Getsu Renge will randomly appear while moving between stages.
  If Puppet Getsu Renge is defeated, Getsu Renge will appear in the Getsu Clan Estate as a playable character.
  * Puppet Getsu Renge will appear on all difficulties.
[previewyoutube=MUjBG3670bY;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Introducing enhancements exclusive to Getsu Renge.
  [*] Getsu Renge's Training Manual is now an in-game drop item.
  Getsu Renge Training Manual will only be found when you play as Getsu Renge, whereas Getsu Fuma's Training Manuals will drop when you play as Getsu Fuma.
  The enhancement item Spirit Mineral (Train) can be used by both Getsu Fuma and Getsu Renge.
  Masteries are a shared feature for all characters in the game. Once unlocked, their effects will be available regardless of which character you are playing.
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Added the "Dismantle" feature.
  To Dismantle a weapon, press and hold the RB (default) button while touching the weapon you no longer want.
  By using Dismantle, you can obtain the Fragments in amounts proportional to the weapon's value
[previewyoutube=hMYt_8G54k8;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Adjusted performance of the game.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*] (Community) Changed the coloring of Berserkers to increase their visibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/9a4beb8a9cef6237a36643290600a43789159e42.png[/img]
  [*] Skeleton Soldier and Skeleton Archer are now increased in size when appearing as Berserkers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/d140e38246e92b61a1bfff0523f6310743adb0c5.png[/img]
  [*] Changed the color of the Skeleton Soldier's katana to increase its visibility.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/0a33766fa70ff0325fd29ab6f001be377f70bc95.png[/img]
  [*] (Community) Changed the Skeleton Archer's attack motion so that there is a longer opening before it attacks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/db95640244a85f7501d6644d7988ebac498012a0.png[/img]
  [*] Enemies will now take less time to disappear after death, and will no longer overlap with other objects on-screen.
  [*] In addition to Coins and Material Pouches, rare weapons, keys for locked stages, and diagrams will now drop on rare occasions from the bosses of each stage.
  [*] The landing animation after jumping or falling from heights can now be cancelled with other actions.
  [*] The staggered motion that occurs after taking damage can now be canceled with an evasive action.
  [*] The mechanism that limited effects of Masteries and Training according to difficulty level has been changed so that it is now applied to all difficulty levels. There are no changes to the rules for obtaining diagrams.
  [*] (Community) Increased chances of materials dropping from enemies.
  [*] (Community) Increased chances of Spirit Mineral (Train) and Spirit Mineral (Master) dropping from enemies.
  [*] (Community) Diagrams, Mastery Books and Training scrolls obtained during the game will no longer be lost upon death.
  [*] (Community) Changed the amount and type of materials needed for unlocking certain Activation skills.
  [*] (Community) Changed the cost requirements for learning the following Masteries: Material Recovery and Spirit Mineral Recovery.
  [*] (Community) Changed the effectiveness of the following Masteries: Material Recovery, Material Recovery: Mastery 1, Spirit Mineral Recovery, and Spirit Mineral Recovery: Mastery 1.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/fc902455c23a8aeeaf44f567d66f06b572a3f351.png]Click here for more details.[/url]
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Fixed a problem where the setting to increase Special Ability parameters would not work properly when using the main weapon's Soul Devour, and some Special Abilities have been enhanced.
  [*] Adjusted the damage of some sub weapons that were causing more damage than expected.
  [*] Adjusted the damage of some sub weapons that were causing less damage than expected.
  [*] Changed one of Raido, the Great Bow's qualities from Ammo + to Cooldown -.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/b0a5665dd554879efb18448bb7ba6cc040f5e2dc.png]Click here to see the detailed changes made to Sub Weapons.[/url]
  [*] The materials required to Unlock Skills have been adjusted. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/c52209706227319a9a5413d1c01b6a4e7a8a249c.png]Click here for more details.[/url]
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
  [*] (Community) The mini-map's transparency has been increased slightly to make it easier to see behind the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/09691769d2b89b92cda347609ba4edbf06585630.png[/img]
  [*] Pop-up messages are no longer displayed during actions.
  [*] Revised options for changing screen resolution.
  [*] Changed the key configuration setup to make it easier to configure.
  [*] Expanded the keyboard configuration to include more keys and options that can be set.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
  [*] Fixed a problem where the setting to increase Special Ability parameters would not work properly when using the main weapon's Soul Devour.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the effect of Enhanced Vitality would be overwritten if the higher-level skill Enhanced Vitality: Mastery 1 was acquired before the Enhanced Vitality Training skill.
  [*] Fixed a problem in which the activation conditions for weapon skills Purple Slash, Orange Slash, Vermilion Slash, Yellow Slash, Blue Slash, Purple Break, Orange Break, Vermilion Break, Yellow Break, and Blue Break referred to the player's own state, rather than the state of the target enemy.
  [*] Fixed a problem where some of Getsu Rando's attacks had no upper hitbox.
  [*] Fixed a problem where enemies did not die from player-inflicted status effects.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the distance needed to disable the effects of the Parasite status effect was too long.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the Geisha Spirit (Turned)'s attacks would end up behind the terrain of the platform and out of sight.
  [*] Fixed a problem where some of the tutorial screenshots were in Japanese.
  [*] Fixed a problem where characters were taking continuous damage upon coming into contact with the spike traps in the Frozen Graveyard.
  [*] Fixed a problem where it was impossible to get the Unwavering achievement even if the conditions were met.
  [*] Fixed a problem where it was possible to get the Indomitable achievement with less than the specified number. There will be no changes for those wo have already received this achievement.
  [*] Fixed an issue where damage would occur when approaching an enemy immediately after their Frozen state had ended.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the Soul Devour Reppu (Minor) Special Ability was not working.
  [*] Fixed a problem where Caltrops would disappear when a player took damage even if the Caltrops were still in effect.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the footsteps sounds in the Getsu Clan Estate were sometimes incorrect.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the wrong song would play when suspending/resuming the game in Misty Peaks.
  [*] Fixed a problem where the models for the main weapons Antique Spear and Keen Spear were swapped in-game.
  [*] Changed the taskbar's application icon from Unreal Engine's to GetsuFumaDen's.
  [*] Some in-game text has been adjusted and changed.
[/list]
[list]
  [*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Known Problems[/h3]
[list]
  [*] We are looking into a problem where the Frozen status does not affect Puppet Getsu Renge.
  [*] There is a problem where Getsu Renge can swing weapons fast even when equipped with a heavy weapon such as a club.
  [*] There is a problem where enemies that spawn in narrow areas of the map do not move correctly.
  [*] We are looking into a problem where unexpected enemies appear in the Frozen Graveyard and The Great Wave of Damnation.
  [*] We are looking into a problem where the destruction animations for some destructible objects are not displaying properly.
  [*] We have confirmed a rare bug where when you pass through the golden Torii gate in Avenue of Pleasure and Illusion, you might be warped to a non-existant area. If this happens, please exit to the Title screen and restart the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315895/b8860aa0e37ea5bf9be6e8ebfc67cbd0aa8e4765.png[/img]

[h1]GetsuFumaDen: Undying Moon
Patch Notes V0.1.11[/h1]	

We want to thank everyone for sending in your feedback. We are currently working on what we have received so far, and will keep on improving the game in future patches and updates!

But for now you can check below what adjustments have been made in V0.1.11:
	
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]	
[list]
  [*] Adjustments have been made to the placement of the blood effects when an attack hit an enemy.
       [Comparison in the placement of the blood effects between V0.1.10 and V0.1.11]
[previewyoutube=sSMzkkJkqzE;full][/previewyoutube]
*We will keep working towards fine tuning the visual of the game based on the feedback received from players.

  [*] Reading a stone monument will now always lead to a Health Potion and Material Pouch dropping.
  [*] Hit box for demons has been changed. Also, it is now harder to be attacked from behind.
[/list]

[h3]System Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
 [*] The number of clears in the saved data was shown by difficulty level. It will now show the total number of clears instead.
 [*] Tutorial images that were showing in Japanese will now show in English.
 [*] Shortened hold button period required to skip cut scenes.
[/list]
	
[h3]Bugs Fixes[/h3]
[list]
 [*] Fixed the issue where players would take continuous damage from the needle trap in "Frozen Graveyard".
 [*] Fixed the issue where some enemies would not take damage when frozen.
 [*] Fixed the issue where some enemies would not die when frozen.
 [*] Fixed the issue where "One-Strike Specialist", "Free Form" and "Slash of Elimination" skill effects were being applied to weapons that were not equipped with those skills.
 [*] Fixed the issue where force quitting the game during the credits would give you multiple clears instead of one clear.
 [*] Fixed the issue where parrying some enemies attacks would result in Flash Damage instead of Crushing Damage.
 [*] Fixed the issue where some screen transitions would cause images to be distorted.
 [*] Fixed the issue where the effects of some debuff would be displayed twice.
 [*] Fixed some incorrect text.
[/list]

Patch Notes V1.0.1[/h1]
